description: Checks Transport for London contactless or Oyster journeys for overcharges: incomplete journeys (no touch out, so the maximum fare was charged) and missed Hopper fares. Takes journey rows from a journey history, or the text of the CSV download from a TfL account. PDFs and images are not accepted. TfL refunds an incomplete journey as the maximum fare minus the fare for the journey actually made. Without the destination, the refund shown is an upper limit equal to the whole charge; with intended_destination on the row, it is an estimate from the usual fare to that station. Returns the refundable journeys and total, older journeys outside TfL’s 8 week window, how to claim in the TfL account, a claim pack and the details needed to save the journeys to an Untap account. It does not check service delays on the Tube, DLR, Elizabeth line or Overground, or Santander Cycles; the result lists these under not_checked. No sign-in needed. Nothing is saved to an account. A record of the check, with no name, account or IP address, is kept for a year so answers can be verified.

csv_text.description: The text of the CSV journey history downloaded from a TfL account. Takes priority over journeys.

bus_route.description: Bus route number for bus rows, otherwise null.

end_time.description: Tap-out time as HH:MM, or null.

fare_pence.description: Charge for this row in pence. £2.20 = 220.

from_location.description: Tap-in station / stop name, or null if not shown.

intended_destination.description: Optional, for an incomplete journey with no touch out: the station the person was travelling to. With it, the refund is estimated as the fare charged minus the usual fare to that station. Without it, the figure is an upper limit equal to the whole charge.

is_auto_corrected.description: Optional. True when the statement says TfL has already corrected this journey (for example "Auto-completed" or "Adjusted").

is_daily_cap_hit.description: Optional. True when the statement marks this row as the one where the daily cap was reached.

is_hopper_free.description: Optional. True when the statement shows this fare as a free Hopper fare (a second bus or tram within 60 minutes).

is_incomplete.description: True if this journey has no tap-out recorded (e.g. label "Incomplete" or "No exit").

is_max_fare.description: True if the statement labels this as a max-fare charge for a failed revenue inspection.

is_weekly_cap_hit.description: Optional. True when the statement marks this row as the one where the weekly cap was reached.

mode.description: Transport mode for this row, or "unknown" when the statement does not say.

start_time.description: Tap-in time as HH:MM, or null.

to_location.description: Tap-out station / stop name, or null for incomplete journeys.

journeys.description: Journey rows from a TfL contactless or Oyster journey history. Used when csv_text is not given.

name: check_tfl_journeys
title: Check TfL journeys for overcharges
